summary.headline: Dragon Head and Tail Significations
summary.text: Discussion of malefic planets in diurnal or nocturnal places, reception, sickness, wounds, and killing. Chapter 24 explains the Moon’s Dragon Head and Tail, including their conjunctions and aspects with Saturn and the effects in Aries, Taurus, airy and watery signs: impediments, winds, rain, famine, cold, locusts, reptiles, and destruction.
